title: Naturality of the constructed single-window identifications
statement: For an abelian category C, q in N and f:K -> L a morphism of nonnegative cochain complexes, the specific component isomorphisms constructed in lem-sp-vertical-window-component-iso commute with the window map of f and the single complex map induced by H^q(f). This asserts naturality only of these constructed comparisons, not of arbitrary isomorphisms.

source.place: Proof steps 1 and 2, canonical single-window comparison

proof.text: Apply single-complex morphism extensionality. In degree q, compose upper-truncation cycles naturality (obtained by passing to opposites), homology projection naturality, inverse naturality of the lower-truncation homology isomorphism, and extendHomologyIso_hom_naturality. Transport this square along q + 1 - 1 = q to match the dependent cast in verticalWindowDegreeIso, then use the constructed component isomorphisms.

lean.statement: theorem verticalWindow_component_naturality (q : ℕ) {K L : CochainComplex C ℕ} (f : K ⟶ L) : (verticalWindow (C := C) (q : ℤ) (q + 1)).map f ≫ (verticalWindowComponentIso q L).hom = (verticalWindowComponentIso q K).hom ≫ (HomologicalComplex.single C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q).map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap f q)
